ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Mars

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.
